blocks.text: Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. called on China to show self-restraint and mutual respect as it meets with ASEAN leaders in Manila, with the Philippines ending its ASEAN chairmanship this year without a final agreement on a Code of Conduct for the South China Sea.
